tactics:
induction l generalizing acc with
| nil => simp [List.filterMapM.loop]
| cons a l ih =>
  simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, map_bind]
  apply bind_congr
  intro x
  cases x with
  | none => simp [ih acc]
  | some b =>
    simp only []
    rw [ih (b :: acc), ih [b]]
    simp [Functor.map_map, List.append_assoc]

induction l generalizing acc with
| nil => simp [List.filterMapM.loop]
| cons a l ih =>
  simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, map_bind]
  congr 1
  funext x
  cases x with
  | none => exact ih acc
  | some b =>
    show List.filterMapM.loop f l (b :: acc) = _ <$> List.filterMapM.loop f l [b]
    rw [ih (b :: acc), ih [b]]
    simp [Functor.map_map]
